key_highlights: ASX sheds $90bn in a week as rate-hike fears and oil price surge pressure miners and banks
Iron ore enters a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern
Oil prices surged as suppression policies failed, lifting Santos.AX and Woodside.AX but raising input costs
ANZ.AX announced 3,500 job cuts as part of restructuring; long runway to profitability
Housing prices correcting with first-home buyer surge; no spring bounce in auction market
Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c/litre on global 'deadly cocktail' of supply shocks
Mining cap-raise activity intensifies (Canaccord-led), signalling capital stress in junior miners
Superannuation reform debate intensifies with populist pressure vs. institutional pushback
Australian businesses report rising fear for future amid cost pressures

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners leading the $90bn index decline. Junior miners scrambling for capital via cap raises. Gold underperforming ('gold schmould').
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Canaccord-led cap raises (headline 48) signal liquidity stress in juniors. Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources, PolarX (headline 42) show selective small-cap strength. Gateway WA and Kuniko gold exploration (74,75) offer speculative upside.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate-hike fears pressure bank valuations. ANZ.AX restructuring (3,500 cuts) signals cost discipline but weak credit growth. RBA rental inflation focus may delay rate cuts.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM pressure if RBA holds higher for longer. Housing correction (60,79) raises credit risk. Superannuation reform debate (40,49,81) could reshape fund flows into bank-managed products.

sectors.trend: Positive for producers, negative for consumers. Oil surge lifts Santos.AX, Woodside.AX. Australia softening local gas supply rules (72) eases Asian LNG fears. Fuel prices rising 30c (45).
sectors.implications: Santos.AX and Woodside.AX benefit from oil/gas price strength. However, 'Australia sacrificed to preserve Santos' (51) raises policy risk. Higher fuel costs feed into CPI, complicating RBA path.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths.AX caught raising 'family staple' prices during Price Freeze (59). Australian businesses fear for future (56). Fuel cost pass-through pressures margins.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WES.AX face margin squeeze and reputational risk. Consumer spending under pressure from tax burden (52) and rising costs. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-negative. Housing prices correcting (60,79) but first-home buyer surge provides floor. No auction spring bounce (35). RBA rental inflation concern (69) supports REIT yields but caps capital growth.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) may see rental income support but capital values under pressure. Property chiefs calling for more migrants (78) signals supply-side urgency.

sectors.trend: Selective. ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon (44). Critical Resources battery tech holds firm (73). Global AI/security theme (6,9,10) provides sentiment support.
sectors.implications: Small-cap momentum names offer tactical upside but high volatility. Battery tech (73) aligns with critical minerals theme. Global AI capex cycle supports sentiment but funding constraints (10) are a risk.

key_themes: Rate-hike fears and rising bond yields driving broad ASX selloff
Iron ore price correction pressuring major miners
AUD weakness on growth scare; commodity-linked currency under pressure
RBA focused on rental inflation, delaying easing cycle
Housing market correction with policy debate on supply and migration
Superannuation reform under populist vs. institutional pressure
Oil/gas price surge benefiting energy but raising inflation risk
Mining sector capital stress; cap-raise activity rising
Consumer cost-of-living pressure across fuel, food, and taxes

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour floating-rate and energy equities; monitor RBA statements on rental inflation
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (despite 'schmould') or energy
Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor AUD/USD
Monitor bank NPLs; favour banks with strong capital buffers (CBA.AX); avoid over-leveraged REITs
Avoid junior miners with imminent cap raises; favour cash-flow-positive majors
Diversify across regions; monitor Arctic shipping (46) and Vanuatu regional risk (15)

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil/gas price surge
opportunities.rationale: Oil suppression failure and gas supply rule easing support Santos.AX, Woodside.AX earnings; LNG demand from Asia remains firm

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical exposure to critical minerals / battery tech
opportunities.rationale: Critical Resources battery tech holding firm (73); structural demand for lithium, copper, rare earths supports long-term thesis

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap momentum in ASX runners
opportunities.rationale: Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon showing relative strength; AI/security theme provides global tailwind

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to iron ore majors; rotate to gold or energy
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; BHP/RIO/FMG face earnings downgrades. Gold underperforming but offers hedge if AUD weakens further

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim consumer staples; favour dividend-paying defensives
defensive_moves.rationale: Woolworths price-freeze breach (59) and rising fuel/tax burden (45,52) pressure consumer margins; shift to high-yield dividend payers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and rate risk via short-duration bonds or AUD puts
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; RBA rental inflation focus delays cuts; rising yields pressure equities

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as rate-hike fears persist, iron ore weakens, and AUD remains under pressure. RBA rental inflation commentary may trigger further volatility. Energy names outperform; miners and banks lag. Fuel price rise (30c) adds to CPI stickiness.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may stabilise with first-home buyer surge. Superannuation reform could unlock capital flows. Energy transition and critical minerals offer structural growth. However, global growth scare and oil volatility create uncertainty. 6-12 month view: ASX 200 to recover if RBA pivots and iron ore stabilises.
